children.name: Polymers shrink as they cool from extrusion temperature, and high-performance materials like PEEK and PEKK shrink unevenly enough to cause warping and weak interlayer welds. Hylo’s actively-heated chamber and Basis’ part-specific thermal profiles are engineered around this exact problem.
